## 4600 - 4619

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04600">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4600 XCOMBO - Low C10+ absolute density</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04600">

This exception is generated when a source analysis record has a C10Plus Absolute Density that falls below the minimum requirement set up in Source Analysis Validations. For example, the minimum quantity for C10Plus Absolute Density is set to 0.05 but the imported quantity for C10Plus Absolute Density is 0.00 and exception 4600 is thrown.

</div>
